sections.name: AboutHero
sections.note: No interactive elements; section is purely presentational.

sections.name: AboutStory
sections.note: Service list uses stock idioms (scale-x rule, number lift) but choreography resolves from primary to tertiary with felt stagger.

sections.name: AboutTiles
sections.note: Center-leading reveal mirrors the offset pattern, but hover feedback is standard zoom+saturate+line-draw.

sections.name: BookingSection
sections.note: Contact interactions delegated to ContactLink component; BookingSection itself has no hover/active/focus states.

sections.name: DualBrandSplit
sections.note: Rule+arrow gesture is connected and specific to this CTA; press is physically coherent (scale differs per mood); demonstrates the dual-token system.

sections.name: EventIndex
sections.note: Choreography applies uniform stagger; no hierarchical progression from primary (accent line) through supporting (tags).

sections.name: FinalCTA
sections.note: StickerSpin is decorative animation, not interaction; micro-craft relies on inherited component behavior.

sections.name: Hero
sections.note: Parallax drift on imagery is subtle, appropriate to content, but not brand-specific—any photo could carry it.

sections.name: Manifesto
sections.note: No interactive elements present; the section is motion-only and cannot express interaction state design.

sections.name: ServiceTicker
sections.note: Only hover state active (diamond rotation); focus-visible, active, and disabled states entirely absent from marquee items.

sections.name: ServicesBento
sections.note: No distinct pressed state; hover and focus effects are identical rather than physically coherent.

sections.name: ServicesHero
sections.note: Interaction states limited to rail-item hover (color + rotation); no focus-visible, pressed, or disabled. Reads as template hero.

sections.name: ServicesLedger
sections.note: Opposite-direction pointer response (number left, label right) is directional and specific; missing distinct focus-visible state beyond global outline.

sections.name: SocietyCTA
sections.note: MagneticButton implementation not shown; no visible interaction states in source. Delay sequence (0.2s, 0.45s, 0.42s) reads arbitrary.

sections.name: SocietyCategories
sections.note: Intentional restraint fits Society mood but reads as quiet/anonymous rather than handcrafted. Stock list-row patterns throughout; no distinctive point of view.

sections.name: SocietyGallery
sections.note: Images have hover-only state (filter + hairline scale-x); no pressed/focus/disabled. Motion uses --ease-entrance (the anonymous generic curve the tokens call out), not a signature choice.

sections.name: SocietyHero
sections.note: Display-only hero with no interactive elements. Delayed rule (0.85s) shows choreographic intent, but motion vocabulary (fade, kinetic reveal, mask, draw) is template-standard; curves are generic entrance, not signature.

sections.name: SocietyStatement
sections.note: Display section with no interactive states. Delayed rule (0.6s) reflects intentional restraint, but motion is stock (kinetic reveal, settle, draw) and easing is generic --ease-entrance, not a brand signature.
